# Quick reference {.unnumbered}

Two tables for when you need a specific answer fast. The first maps common reviewer comments to the chapter that addresses them. The second maps figure problems to the chapters that cover them.

## If your reviewer said…

| Reviewer comment | Where to look |
|:----------------|:-------------|
| "The abstract doesn't state the main finding" | Ch. 2 — Abstract section |
| "The introduction is too long / too broad" | Ch. 2 — Introduction section |
| "The key result is buried in a subordinate clause" | Ch. 3 — Stress position |
| "You report p-values without confidence intervals" | Ch. 4 — Statistical significance |
| "Your methods and results use different terminology" | Statistical writing chapter |
| "The sensitivity analysis contradicts your primary result" | Statistical writing chapter — Discordant sensitivity analysis |
| "You don't discuss what happens when data are missing" | Statistical writing chapter — Missing-data paragraph |
| "I couldn't tell what the figure shows without reading the methods" | Ch. 13 — Captions |
| "Your y-axis doesn't start at zero" | Ch. 12 — Pitfall 3 (Truncated y-axis) |
| "Colours are indistinguishable to colour-blind readers" | Ch. 14 — Colour-vision deficiency |
| "The figure contradicts the results text" | Ch. 10 — Principles |
| "Too many pie charts" | Ch. 12 — Pitfall 1 (Pie chart) |
| "The figure uses a rainbow palette" | Ch. 12 — Pitfall 2 / Ch. 14 — Sequential palettes |
| "I can't find the dataset or analysis code" | Open science chapter |
| "The citation doesn't say what you say it says" | Ch. 7 — Citation hygiene |
| "I'm not sure who actually wrote this" | AI writing chapter |
| "Ghost authorship / I can't identify the contribution" | Ch. 8 — CRediT and authorship |
| "The reporting checklist item is incomplete" | Ch. 6 — Reporting guidelines |
| "The English is non-native but the argument is unclear" | Writing in a second language chapter |

## If your figure fails at…

| Problem | Where to look |
|:--------|:-------------|
| Choosing the right chart type for your data | Ch. 11 — Chart types |
| A palette that is not perceptually uniform | Ch. 14 — Sequential palettes / CVD |
| An incomplete or under-specified caption | Ch. 13 — Captions |
| Bars that don't start at zero | Ch. 12 — Pitfall 3 |
| Too many categories in one panel | Ch. 14 — Categorical palettes (max 8) |
| File format or resolution for journal submission | Ch. 14 — Preparing figures for submission |
| Dual-axis confusion | Ch. 12 — Pitfall 5 |
| Mean ± SE bars hiding the distribution | Ch. 12 — Pitfall 6 |
| Code-generated figure with unverified values | Ch. 15 — Code-generation tools |
